current_focus.summary: Implement the accepted Inventory-only whole-basket CheckoutInventoryPort adapter using existing single-pool transaction machinery. Prove no partial basket, no oversell, durable response-loss/restart recovery, duplicate idempotency, terminal release races and binding conflicts. Do not alter Commerce/Payments, stock truth ownership or independent TTL policy.

decisions.choice: DinkusKit operates the default hosted Inventory service. Shop owners install the sandboxed EmDash Registry plugin and configure inventory through EmDash without configuring Cloudflare, deploying Workers, or copying infrastructure credentials. The Inventory service remains the sole stock authority per pool.
